scope: Native scalar root-existence API, Session/NDJSON portability, and governed rational binary scaling
continuous original scalar expression on the complete requested closed interval
exact rational request endpoints and positive width tolerance
odd repeated, nonsmooth, and endpoint roots within the existing bounded evaluator

scalar_brackets.ownership: Distinct bracket: handles; at most 32 resident accepted brackets; source and context retained; output admission before insertion.
scalar_brackets.transport: Canonical bounded artifact binds original typed source, ordered axes, complete request interval, tolerance and receiver context. Untrusted witness is independently verified; no serialized accepted flag or generator retry.
scalar_brackets.streaming: Distinct scalar_root_bracket artifact kind with appended stable digest tag 11; existing chunk integrity and complete-transfer checks precede protected replay.
scalar_brackets.resource_semantics: Candidate generation uses ordinary resources; mathematical verification uses the protected verifier lease; cancellation and budget failure publish no new handle and do not refund spent work.

arithmetic.behavior: Compute exact signed binary scaling with checked output height/capacity, charged fallible digit-buffer reservation, linear digit/carry work and checkpoints before each digit write.
arithmetic.integration: Governed nearest and directed binary64 conversion uses the direct shift at all six exact binary-scaling call sites, replacing repeated powers-of-two multiplication.
arithmetic.failure_semantics: Meter failures propagate unchanged. Checked size or buffer-allocation refusal returns None from rational conversion without resetting resources or choosing an unmetered fallback.
arithmetic.policy: Existing multiplication kernels, thresholds and selection defaults are unchanged.
arithmetic.materialization_limit: The direct base-2^32 buffer is preflighted, charged and fallibly reserved. The provisional num-bigint substrate subsequently repacks those digits into native limbs with an infallible allocation and no internal cancellation safe points. That repack is charged and checkpointed immediately before and after execution; typed allocator failure and size-independent cancellation latency are not guaranteed inside it.
arithmetic.performance_claim: No wall-time, speedup or benchmark result is established.
